title: Gift of Peace
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · Gift of Peace · A1:H60 · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit#gid=1834698990
body:
← Browse all blessings

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 11cost
Tier 22cost
Tier 33cost
Theme 1

The Pacifist

Tier 1Cost 1

You have advantage on all persuasion and performance checks to avoid violence, and all who can hear your words have advantage on insight checks for the next hour

Full original wording

Every word you speak carries a gentle light, settling unrest and soothing the fiercest hearts. You have advantage on all persuasion and performance checks to avoid violence, and all who can hear your words have advantage on insight checks for the next hour

Tier 2Cost 2

Once per day, you can replicate the effects of the antipathy/sympathy spell, but you can only select the sympathy component

Full original wording

Those who cross your path find their hearts softened, their defenses lowered by your quiet charm. Once per day, you can replicate the effects of the antipathy/sympathy spell, but you can only select the sympathy component

Tier 3Cost 3

Within your presence, weapons falter and shrink, their deadly edges blunted by an unseen force. As a bonus action you summon an aura of protection, for one minute, all creatures within 30 feet of you have a -5 to their attack rolls

Full original wording

Within your presence, weapons falter and shrink, their deadly edges blunted by an unseen force. As a bonus action you summon an aura of protection, for one minute, all creatures within 30 feet of you have a -5 to their attack rolls

Theme 2

The Negotiator

Tier 1Cost 1

Once per short rest, if you are called to make an insight check against a deception check, you can simply choose to succeed if possible through dice rolls.

Full original wording

Deception smells bitter to you—an unmistakable stench that sets your instincts blazing. Once per short rest, if you are called to make an insight check against a deception check, you can simply choose to succeed if possible through dice rolls.

Tier 2Cost 2

Targets have disadvantage on saves on all of your enchantment spells

Full original wording

You are a master of weaving desires, your magic a net that traps the will of your foes. Targets have disadvantage on saves on all of your enchantment spells

Tier 3Cost 3

You recognize the whispers of power in every relic, understanding their secrets as if they spoke only to you. You may have two legendary items, provided both of the are wondrous items

Full original wording

You recognize the whispers of power in every relic, understanding their secrets as if they spoke only to you. You may have two legendary items, provided both of the are wondrous items

Theme 3

The Martyr

Tier 1Cost 1

Allies within 30 feet of you have advantage on death saving throws. You have disadvantage

Full original wording

Servant's Heart: Your greatest vulnerability lies in the very hearts you fight to protect—the strength of your allies is the thread that binds and unravels you. Allies within 30 feet of you have advantage on death saving throws. You have disadvantage

Tier 2Cost 2

This lasts for 10 minutes and can only be used once per long rest

Full original wording

Your connection is a living conduit of strength, a bridge over which your might flows freely. You may chose a bonded partner. You may sacrifice up to 3 of your AC. Your partner gains an equal bonus to their AC. This lasts for 10 minutes and can only be used once per long rest

Tier 3Cost 3

When an ally you can see dies, you may use your reaction to take their place. If you do, you immediately fall to two death saves and must make a death saving throw. They are then healed for 6d8 hit points, and all status conditions are removed from them.

Full original wording

You embody selflessness, accepting hardship so that others may stand unbroken. When an ally you can see dies, you may use your reaction to take their place. If you do, you immediately fall to two death saves and must make a death saving throw. They are then healed for 6d8 hit points, and all status conditions are removed from them.
